text.content: Date: Aug 23, 2026 | Timezone: America/Toronto | Retrieved: 05:00 EDT | Audience: Trevor Longino. Freshness sweep ran before category scan. Search families: 12. Discovery candidates: 48. Thesis-deduplicated: 29. Scored: 12. Included: 4 signals plus 4 watch items. Transcript-backed videos: 0. Primary artifacts inspected: 7.

Qwen/model cards: QwenCloud lists qwen3.8-27b on Aug 19, but the model launch and local deployment thesis were already covered Aug 19–22; late/repeated, not promoted. Qwen3.8-27B remains a watch target for independent reproduction.
Glimmer/Muse: Meta primary release is Aug 10 and already covered; no new first-party Muse artifact found in the window. Community quantization claims were retained as watch-only.

Abliterated/unrestricted: current search returned Qwen3.8 derivatives and the July arXiv study, but no new primary release or independent evaluation after the Aug 21 coverage. Excluded from Top Signals as repeated/project-claim material.

Runtime/serving: llama.cpp b10549 (Aug 21) adds tensor split for LFM2/LFM2MOE; vLLM v0.28.0rc2 (Aug 21) adds DFlash2 local convolution and candidate selector. These are concrete deltas after the prior b10509/Diffusers coverage.

Efficiency/research: Liquid AI QAD Q4_0 checkpoints and IBM/Hugging Face ALTK-Evolve memory-dose results provide concrete quantization and agent-memory experiments. ExactMoE and AgentSysBench are late-discovered Aug 15 papers, useful corroboration but not same-day news.

Promoted: llama.cpp b10549 (primary, score 9); vLLM v0.28.0rc2 DFlash2 (primary, score 8); Liquid AI QAD Q4_0 (vendor/project claim, score 8); ALTK-Evolve memory calibration (vendor/research post, score 8). Watch: AgentSysBench (primary but submitted Aug 15); ExactMoE (primary, submitted Aug 15); WebGPU dispatch overhead (primary, date not in current search result); GLM-5.3 delayed weights (secondary reports, date/release status unresolved).

Excluded: Qwen3.8-27B launch and Muse Glimmer release because they were covered in the Aug 19–22 canonical pages without a material new delta; generic llama.cpp/vLLM tutorials; abliterated-model headlines without a new primary artifact or independent evaluation; hardware/policy headlines that remained intermediary or secondary; AI Engineer videos without verified rendered metadata and captions; AgentSysBench/ExactMoE from Aug 15 as late-discovered corroboration rather than current news.
